option_description: Attests the workload runs WITHOUT --privileged (no ALL-caps, no host devices, seccomp+MAC intact).
security_impact: OR-trigger for "Privileged mode / excessive capabilities" — fires when false (HostConfig.Privileged=true). The single largest container-escape primitive (T1611).

option_description: Attests CapDrop=[ALL] with minimal CapAdd and no CAP_SYS_ADMIN/PTRACE/MODULE/DAC_READ_SEARCH/NET_RAW.
security_impact: OR-trigger for "Privileged mode / excessive capabilities" — fires when false; CAP_SYS_ADMIN alone re-enables the CVE-2022-0492 cgroupfs escape (T1611).

how_to_obtain.expected_output: drop:[ALL] + minimal add (secure); empty drop or dangerous add (insecure)

security_impact: OR-trigger for "Host namespace sharing & sensitive host bind-mounts" — fires when false; hostPID/hostNetwork/hostIPC collapse namespace isolation (T1611).

option_description: Attests no bind-mount of /var/run/docker.sock or host /, /proc, /sys, /var/lib/docker.
security_impact: OR-trigger for "Host namespace sharing & sensitive host bind-mounts" — fires when false; the docker.sock mount = full daemon control / host takeover (T1610).

how_to_obtain.expected_output: no docker.sock or host /, /proc, /sys (secure); any present (insecure)

option_description: Attests seccomp default/custom allowlist in effect AND AppArmor/SELinux MAC profile active (not unconfined).
security_impact: OR-trigger for "Weak kernel-sharing confinement" — fires when false; seccomp+MAC jointly block the CVE-2022-0492 cgroup release_agent escape (T1611).

option_description: Attests no-new-privileges:true AND non-root user (or userns-remap so container-root != host-root).
security_impact: OR-trigger for "Weak kernel-sharing confinement" — fires when false; setuid in-container privesc (T1068) and UID-0 maps to host root on escape.

how_to_obtain.instruction: Read no-new-privileges, user, and daemon userns-remap.

option_description: Attests runc >= 1.1.12 (post-CVE-2024-21626) and a current containerd/Docker engine.
security_impact: Trigger for "Unpatched container runtime" — fires when false; runc <= 1.1.11 (CVE-2024-21626) or <= 1.0-rc6 (CVE-2019-5736) yield host root (T1611).

option_description: Attests ReadonlyRootfs=true (writable paths via tmpfs/volumes only).
security_impact: Trigger for "Writable root filesystem / weak post-compromise hardening" — fires when false; a mutable rootfs enables persistence + the runc-overwrite step of CVE-2019-5736 (T1222).

option_description: Attests memory, CPU, and PIDs cgroup limits all bounded.
security_impact: Trigger for "Missing cgroup resource limits (noisy-neighbour DoS)" — fires when false; unbounded → host RAM/CPU/PID exhaustion denying co-tenants (T1499/T1496).

how_to_obtain.expected_output: Memory>0 AND a CPU limit AND PidsLimit>0 (secure); any 0/unbounded (insecure)

option_description: Attests image pinned by @sha256 digest AND signature/content-trust verified (DCT/Cosign).
security_impact: OR-trigger for "Untrusted / unverified image at the supply-chain boundary" — fires when false; a floating/unsigned tag lets untrusted code cross the boundary (T1610/T1525).

how_to_obtain.expected_output: sha256 digest + DCT=1/cosign verify (secure); floating tag / no verify (insecure)

option_description: Attests no plaintext credentials/keys/tokens baked into image layers/ENV/build-args.
security_impact: OR-trigger for "Untrusted / unverified image at the supply-chain boundary" — fires when false; embedded secrets are extractable by anyone who can pull the image (T1552).

how_to_obtain.instruction: Review image build history for secrets.
how_to_obtain.expected_output: no plaintext credentials in any layer/ENV (secure)
